title: %distance — great-circle distance between two points
purpose: Compute the Haversine distance between two lat/lng coordinates in kilometers.
notes: Arguments are lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2; the result is a number (#) in kilometers by default.
Pass a fifth "miles" or "mi" argument for miles.
Coordinates outside lat +/-90 or lng +/-180 resolve to ~.
Output is a TS shortest-round-trip float (last-digit f64 differs cross-language); verified in TS only.
